Bug_Title: RANGE: Array length is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_LENGTH)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and length parameter, but the length is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the loop iterates up to the 'length' parameter without checking if 'length' exceeds the actual length of the array. This will result in an IndexOutOfBoundsException when 'length' is greater than the array's length.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with an array of length 5 and a length parameter of 10, which triggers an IndexOutOfBoundsException because the loop attempts to access elements beyond the array's bounds.
